reason: I already have two or three numbers I call for this kind of work and they pick up fast -- why would I download a new app and hand my job to someone I've never used, especially when you're telling me yourself there are barely any completed bookings near me yet.
objection: If the number of actual jobs done near me is still small, the ratings don't mean much -- I can't tell if these are real reliable pros or just the first few people who signed up.
would_change_my_mind: If a few people in my own street or WhatsApp group actually used it and the freelancer near me had a real track record of jobs done, not just a badge, I'd try it once for something my usual contacts can't do.
